Title: Update to new blogger editor & consequences

Messages.Author: extrala
Messages.Body:
Somewhat off-topic, but only somewhat ..

I have been using blogger/blogspot (as provided by Google) as blogging platform for well over 5 years now, but Google in its eternal wisdom decided to introduce a new interface/editor earlier this year. At first this was optional, but on September 20th they made it mandatory for users.

Since the new interface is almost unusable for me (contrast, posts overview, navigation in general, etc. etc.), I am really considering switching to WordPress (although that will be a pain in the a.. as well).

Since there are some VTES bloggers, which are using blogger/blogspot as well, I wanted ask about their opinion:  Can you work well with the new interface? Are you considering switching as well? Anyone has experience with WordPress (or any recommendations for another blogging platform)?
